_comment: THE MACHINERY - model 41601, the centrepiece of the room Kamer adds
to each farm block, read out of Models/Finished/41601.prefab in his
'Windmills of Daggerfall' v2.0, vendored with the author's permission
(see README.md).
The prefab is a root GameObject drawing 41601.dae with two children,
each drawing its own DAE and each carrying one of his two scripts:
Plank_Gear  Plank_Gear.dae  Spin_Up.cs          Rotate(0, 0, -13*dt, Self)
Roller      Roller.dae      SpinTime_Roller.cs  Rotate(13*dt, 0, 0, Self)
The children reference the MESH ASSET of their DAE directly (m_Mesh
into the file), not the imported node hierarchy, so the DAE's own
node matrix was never applied in his scene: the mesh is the raw
vertex data, and the child's transform below is the whole placement.
That is why the bake reads these two with the node matrix IGNORED
where the sail and the tower have theirs ASSERTED - the tower is a
bare mesh too, but its node matrix happens to be the one whose
composition with Z-up-to-Y-up is the identity, so the assertion
there is a re-export guard and not a transform.
Positions and quaternions (x, y, z, w) are Unity's, verbatim, in the
root's space, which is the space the port draws in (mat4's
handedness law). The rates are degrees per second about the child's
OWN axis after its rotation - Space.Self - and the signs are his.
loopsSound is Spin_Up.Start: it adds a DaggerfallAudioSource and sets
SoundClips.ArenaFireDaemon to LoopOnAwake, so the part that carries
Spin_Up hums; SpinTime_Roller adds none. (A second source in the same
method is never given a clip - BlowingWindIntro is commented out.)
Materials, in each DAE's triangle order, from the prefab's
MeshRenderer lists through the .mat files whose names ARE the
classic (archive, record) pair. Plank_Gear.dae declares nine
materials and draws one; only the drawn one is bound.
